My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
• Just now
I'm sorry to hear that your order arrived damaged. Let me help you with the next steps.
Here's what you should do:
1. Document the damage
Take clear photos of:
The damaged packaging itself
The entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
A common object next to the damage (for scale)
The law tag showing the barcode (both front and back if available)
If it's an assembly-required item, verify that all parts are included.
2. Contact our support team
Email the photos and a description of the damage to support@avocadomattress.com. Include your order details, email, and current shipping address for faster processing. Our team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps.
Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed to make the replacement item. You should receive a confirmation email within 12-72 hours after reporting the damage.
If you'd like, I can connect you with a team member right away to help you get this started. Would that be helpful?
